title: GPS / Live Location Stale or Wrong
problem: Employees report vehicle location on map does not update or shows wrong position, making pickup coordination impossible.
hypothesis: GPS ping interval too infrequent on driver device
Location events delayed in backend pipeline
UI renders cached location rather than latest event
Issue concentrated in specific device or network types
fix: Reduce GPS ping interval; add freshness timestamp to UI; alert employee when last update was >60s ago.
success_metric: 95% of live locations refreshed within 30s; ETA error < 3 min
rollback: Feature flag to revert ping interval

title: Crash / Freeze / Login Failures
problem: App crashes on launch, freezes mid-trip, or OTP/login fails — preventing employees from booking or tracking rides.
hypothesis: Memory leak on main thread causing ANR
OTP delivery failure due to SMS provider issues
fix: Instrument Crashlytics; fix ANR hot-paths; add fallback OTP channel.

title: No / Delayed Push Notifications
problem: Employees miss cab arrival alerts because push notifications are not delivered or arrive very late.
hypothesis: FCM delivery failure in poor network conditions
Background process killed by Android Doze mode
No SMS / in-app fallback when push fails
fix: Add SMS fallback; test on Doze-restricted devices; monitor FCM delivery rate.
success_metric: Notification delivery rate > 99% within 60s of trigger
rollback: SMS fallback is additive; no rollback needed

title: Driver Not Assigned or Assignment Delayed
problem: Employees receive trip confirmation but no driver is assigned, leaving them stranded.
hypothesis: Driver pool exhausted for certain zones / time windows
Assignment algorithm fails silently when no driver available
Employee not notified of assignment failure
fix: Show explicit 'no driver available' state; trigger early re-dispatch or alternate option.
success_metric: Driver assigned within 5 min for >95% of confirmed bookings

title: Check-in / No-show Disputes
problem: Employees are incorrectly marked as no-shows despite being present at pickup point.
hypothesis: Driver marks no-show before employee arrives
No dispute-resolution flow in employee app
fix: Expand geofence with grace window; add in-app dispute button; require photo evidence.
success_metric: Disputed no-shows < 1% of trips; resolution time < 24h

title: Support Unresponsive / Complaints Unresolved
problem: Employees escalate issues but receive no response or resolution, eroding trust in the product.
hypothesis: Support team not receiving escalations from app
No SLA or ticket tracking visible to employee
fix: Add in-app ticket status; integrate with helpdesk; show resolution ETA.
